clue.text: Vote without putting pen to paper

definitions.text: Vote without putting pen to paper

parts.words: Vote without putting pen to paper
parts.note: a vote cast with no ballot paper at all, by raising arms in a meeting

explanation.surface: Someone casts a vote but refuses to write anything down.
explanation.definitionFit: A count of raised arms is a way of voting that needs no written ballot.

clue.text: Traveller wanting nothing more than a warm place by the fire

indicators.note: more than means the second piece is added on beyond the first, coming after it

parts.words: a warm place by the fire
parts.note: a hob is a shelf beside an old fireplace where things are kept warm
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A tramp asks for no more than a warm spot by the hearth.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramp who wanders the roads in search of work is a traveller, chiefly in American usage.

clue.text: Cover over the said tap

indicators.note: the said marks a word as spoken, so its sound rather than spelling counts

parts.note: a rap is a sharp knock or tap

explanation.surface: An instruction to put a cover over the tap just mentioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the said' looks like legal language for 'the aforementioned', but it signals a soundalike: RAP spoken gives the spelling with a silent W.
explanation.definitionFit: To envelop something is to cover it over, folding material round it.

clue.text: Boost the ego even more so

definitions.meaning: to praise someone excessively so they feel good about themselves
comparative of level, as in a surface more even than another

explanation.surface: Puffing someone up further still.
explanation.definitionFit: Praise that pleases someone's vanity, and also the comparative of flat, meaning more level or even.

clue.text: Northern-style boy

parts.note: a la is French for in the style of

explanation.surface: A lad brought up in the manner of the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Northern-style' reads as 'a la N', in the style of N.
explanation.definitionFit: A common male first name, so a boy's name.

clue.text: Sleeping dram not prepared

indicators.note: prepared suggests the letters are made ready in a new order

explanation.surface: A drink of spirits sits untouched, not yet poured out.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inactive or asleep, like a volcano at rest, is in a sleeping state.

clue.text: And it no more was arranged as part of a fraction

indicators.note: was arranged tells us the letters of the preceding words are reordered

explanation.surface: Something that had been arranged now no longer exists as a fraction.
explanation.definitionFit: The bottom number of a fraction, below the line, is one of its two parts.

clue.text: Drink left after being out of date

indicators.note: after places the word for left behind the word for date

parts.note: a vintage is the year a wine was made, its date
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Something left over to drink once it has passed its use-by date.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being out of' only joins the pieces; 'out of date' reads as stale but 'date' alone is the year of a wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine from a single declared year is a fine drink.

clue.text: Still one is supposed to be found in the mountains

definitions.text: is supposed to be found in the mountains

parts.note: still and yet both mean up to now or nevertheless
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone is still thought to be up in the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: The Abominable Snowman is a creature believed by some to live in the Himalayas.

clue.text: A word to conjure with

parts.note: the idiom means an influential name, but literally it is a magic word spoken by a conjuror

explanation.surface: Praise for a name with great influence.
explanation.definitionFit: A magician's incantation is literally a word used for conjuring tricks.

clue.text: All in France look out for ous tom

definitions.meaning: to solicit business, pressing goods on passers-by

explanation.surface: Everyone in France is on the lookout for trade.
explanation.definitionFit: French for everything, and also a verb for touting, soliciting customers persistently.

clue.text: Inconsiderate but took more action presumably

definitions.meaning: read as two words, pondered less, which presumably leaves more time for doing

explanation.surface: Someone acted without considering others, perhaps by being more active.
explanation.definitionFit: Inconsiderate means careless of others; split, the word says one pondered less, so presumably acted more.

clue.text: Has not sufficiently crushed the resistance movement

definitions.meaning: split, the phrase means milled too little, under and ground
a secret organisation fighting an occupying power

explanation.surface: An occupying army has failed to stamp out the partisans.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret resistance organisation is so called, and read as two words it means milled insufficiently.

clue.text: Fly round one city in West Germany

indicators.note: round means the first word encircles the second

parts.note: to hover is to fly while staying in one place
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: Flying in circles around a single West German city.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in Lower Saxony, part of the former West Germany.

clue.text: Hard to describe these mountains

definitions.meaning: difficult, full of obstacles, or like stone
the adjective naming a North American range

explanation.surface: It is difficult to put these peaks into words.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough or difficult path is described this way, and it names the great North American range.

clue.text: Making one single section in Greek capital

parts.note: a unit is a single section or part

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: G is the capital letter of Greek

explanation.surface: Forming a single unit within a Greek capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek capital' suggests Athens, but it means the first letter of Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: Bringing things together into a whole is joining them.

clue.text: In Peru surprisingly seize power

indicators.note: In signals the answer is contained within the following words

explanation.surface: A surprise coup in Peru.
explanation.definitionFit: To take a throne or authority wrongfully is to seize power.

clue.text: Right house for cook

parts.note: an oast house is a kiln building for drying hops

explanation.surface: The right home for a chef.
explanation.walkthrough: An OAST is a hop-drying kiln of the Kent countryside, often called an oast house.
explanation.definitionFit: To cook meat in an oven is a method of cooking.

clue.text: He employs us with hesitation

parts.note: er is the sound of a hesitation

explanation.surface: An employer hesitantly takes us on.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who uses something is the one who employs it.

clue.text: Small creature used to be quiet

parts.note: was is a past form meaning used to be
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

explanation.surface: A little animal that once was silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A stinging insect is a small creature.

clue.text: Garment right to be used in the short play

indicators.note: to be used in places the letter inside the word that follows

parts.note: a skit is a short comic sketch or play

explanation.surface: A costume fit for a brief play.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing hanging from the waist is a garment.

clue.text: Holy place can and must be changed

indicators.note: be changed shows the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shrine must alter its ways.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner sanctuary of a temple is a holy place.

clue.text: Circular frame used by a doctor during thetrip

indicators.note: during places one thing inside the time span of another

parts.note: a tour is a trip
MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: A medic brings an embroidery hoop on a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: The OCR has run 'the trip' together; the meaning is unaffected.
explanation.definitionFit: An embroidery hoop, two concentric rings holding fabric taut, is a round frame.

clue.text: Road up?

parts.note: a road that is literally elevated or lofty, a raised route

explanation.surface: A notice of roadworks.
explanation.definitionFit: A main public road, read as a lofty route, a way that is up.

clue.text: Games room?

parts.note: a sitting room where Victorian families played charades and similar amusements

explanation.surface: A room for playing games.
explanation.definitionFit: A sitting room gives its name to the traditional indoor games played there.

clue.text: He comes back at Christmas

indicators.note: comes back means the word for Christmas is read backwards

parts.note: Noel is another word for Christmas

explanation.surface: A man who returns home for the festive season.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name, so a he.

clue.text: One after Tuesday shortly arranged the needle-case

indicators.note: after places the numeral at the end
arranged says the letters of the shortened day are put in a new order

parts.note: Tue is the short form of Tuesday
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone sorts out the sewing kit on Tuesday.
explanation.definitionFit: A small ornamental case for needles is a crossword staple.

clue.text: Things done while caught in inside

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation within the word for while

parts.note: as means while, at the same time that
ct is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: Deeds performed while trapped indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Deeds are things done.

clue.text: Above-board but not close

explanation.surface: Honest but distant.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank and honest dealing, and also the opposite of shut.

clue.text: Medical hearing-aid

parts.note: not a device for the deaf but an instrument helping a doctor listen to the chest

explanation.surface: A device for the hard of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor's listening tube helps the physician hear heart and lungs.

clue.text: Went down with all hopes dashed

explanation.surface: A ship sank and all hope was lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Past form of sink, as a vessel going under, and also meaning ruined or doomed.

clue.text: Ubiquitous honour in returning the gift

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

indicators.note: returning means the little word in is read backwards

parts.note: a present is a gift

explanation.surface: Being everywhere, an honour gets returned with the gift.
explanation.walkthrough: OM is the Order of Merit, an honour given by the British monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Being present everywhere at once is being found all over.
